courseDetail.title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
courseDetail.description: Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern frameworks to build real world websites.

overview.about:
This comprehensive web development bootcamp is designed to take you from a complete beginner to a pro web developer. You will learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks through hands-on projects and real-world examples. By the end of this course, you will be able to build stunning websites, work with APIs, and deploy your own projects.

Whether you want to start a career in web development, build your own website, or enhance your skills, this course provides everything you need to succeed.
overview.whoIsThisFor: This course is perfect for beginners, students, professionals looking to switch careers, and anyone who wants to learn web development from scratch.
whatYouWillLearn: Understand the fundamentals of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Work with popular frameworks and libraries
Create real-world projects and build a portfolio
Learn best practices and industry standards
overview.requirements: No prior programming experience is required. All you need is a computer with an internet connection and a willingness to learn.
overview.certification: Upon successful completion of the course, you will receive a verified certificate that you can add to your resume and LinkedIn profile.

faqs.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, this course is designed specifically for complete beginners. We start from the absolute basics and gradually move to advanced concepts.

faqs.question: How long will I have access to the course?
faqs.answer: You will have lifetime access to the course materials, including all future updates and additions.

faqs.question: Will I receive a certificate upon completion?
faqs.answer: Yes, you will receive a verifiable Certificate of Completion that you can share on your resume and LinkedIn profile.

faqs.question: Can I access the course on my mobile device?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Our platform is fully responsive, and you can watch the lessons on your smartphone, tablet, or TV.

faqs.question: Do I need any special software installed?
faqs.answer: No special software is required. We will guide you through installing a free code editor (like VS Code) and a web browser during the first few lessons.

faqs.question: Is there a refund policy if I don't like the course?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you are not satisfied with the course, you can request a full refund within the first 30 days.
